copy.tagline_en: Integrate Microsoft Teams channels into your app

howto.what: 这个技能为项目自动添加 Microsoft Teams 聊天渠道：复制并注册 Teams 适配器、安装依赖、构建测试；然后用 Teams CLI 登录、创建机器人、保存凭证、设置图标，引导安装应用到 Teams，并把机器人与你的账户绑定。
howto.when: 当你说要接入 Microsoft Teams、添加 Teams 渠道或配置 Teams 机器人时触发；若 .env 已有凭证则跳过配置。

say.text: 给项目加上 Microsoft Teams 集成
say.note: 技能会自动开始复制和配置

say.text: 帮我创建 Teams 机器人
say.note: 引导你登录并创建机器人

say.text: 让助手能接收 Teams 消息
say.note: 完成安装并绑定到你的账户

howto.what_en: Automatically integrates Teams chat: copies/registers the adapter, installs the pinned dependency, builds & tests. If no stored credentials, it runs Teams CLI setup: login, create bot, save creds, set icons, guide install, link bot.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to add Microsoft Teams integration, a Teams channel, or configure a Teams bot. If .env already has Teams credentials, it skips setup.

say_en.text: Add Microsoft Teams integration to the project.
Help me create a Teams bot.
say_en.note: Prompts for Microsoft sign-in and creates the bot.

say_en.text: Make the assistant receive Teams messages.
say_en.note: Guides you to install the app and link the account.
